title: tester-army/e2e brings natural-language tests to web and mobile apps
friendlyTitle: Write app tests in normal language
summary: tester-army/e2e is an actively developed end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile applications, with natural-language, agentic test workflows and replayable test evidence. The repository has about 2,900 stars and remains pre-1.0, so interfaces may still change.
friendlySummary: This project lets teams describe web and mobile tests in plain language. It can run those tests automatically and keep evidence of what happened.
whyItMatters: Development teams can use it to express user journeys in plain language and run them on pull requests or schedules. Its recorded evidence and security-conscious handling of test artifacts are especially relevant when AI participates in quality assurance.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help teams test real user journeys without writing every step as traditional test code. The project is still before version 1.0, so expect some changes.
